summary: 10 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • openspec-prompts: clarify slash command skill handling (a0e7333)
  • vscode-server: manage per-target Code Server instances (29bf46a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • layout: extend phone layouts and controls to tablet widths (efe85a3)
  • session: show full remote details in the recent repo menu (4d85b9d)
  • preset-task: add touch hero selection and inline actions (8802e7d)
  • chat: improve phone history and composer interactions (a590d0b)
  • vault: add direct access zones to project and vault cards (73601d8)
  • scheduled-plan: edit one occurrence or the whole series (26aa884)
  • vscode-server: manage multiple server instances (2012907)
  • mermaid: add dependency reveal and graph tracing (d4b433b)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • project-git-refresh: resolve watcher keys and stale refreshes (4748764)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: improve recent repository host label contrast (82304ee)
